mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a beautiful clear morning with a temperature of 63 degrees near the Verona Area High School.

The City of Verona has officially adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan following a unanimous vote by the Common Council. This long-range strategy, developed with extensive community input, will serve as a roadmap for sustainable growth, housing, and infrastructure over the next decade.

There is plenty to do in town today, starting with trivia at both Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Yoga at Insight Wellness, or evening trivia at The Mill, The Bogey Factory, and Paddy Mac's.

Looking at the weekly police report, on October 3, a 19-year-old man was arrested for being a felon in possession of a firearm following an investigation that began with a traffic stop for expired registration.
Today's flavor of the day is OREO Cookie Cheesecake, and you can pick it up when the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
